title: Single Product Details Page Redesign
summary: Revamped the single product overview layout with enhanced barcode display, quick stock overview, and brand styling.
details: New camera badge on product image thumbnail.
Inline quick 'Add Inventory' button beside live stock counts.
Clear specification display for Minimum Stock, Selling Price, and Taxable rules.

title: Create Similar Product Feature
summary: Easily clone existing products directly from the Manage dropdown menu.
details: Directly opens the matching product type (Serialized, Stock, Service).
Category and Manufacturer (Make) are automatically pre-selected.
Prices and stock rules pre-filled so you only need to adjust the product name.

title: Invoice Quick Search & Auto-Suggestions
summary: Global header search bar for instant invoice lookup by number or customer name.
details: Real-time suggestions as you type invoice numbers (e.g. SA-001).
One-click navigation directly to invoice details.
